title: StreamLabs Water Event Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume/Flo/HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=streamlabs:water
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(location) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many StreamLabs water event events land each day and how many distinct location values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest StreamLabs water event records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct location values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts how much StreamLabs water event activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
